case: Dense street-tree crowns east of the Flower Street parking garage
axes: arrays indexed [row, column], bounds [column0, row0, column1, row1] in the 1 m rotated project grid

sources.top,mean,low,count,passthru: USGS 3DEP CA_LosAngeles_1_B23 (2023), cached lidar.npz and dtm.npy; heights in metres above local DEM

sources.building: Rasterized cached OpenStreetMap building footprints; nonzero means mapped building
sources.published: Baseline 1 m solid-tile height above ground, excluding the separately exported foliage

expected: Four disconnected solid objects of 79, 56, 64 and 52 cells are dense crown interiors; at least 90% of each receives whole-crown support. Mapped building cells remain excluded.
provenance: USGS/USDA public-domain data; OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL. This crop is for regression testing, not a surveyed tree-species or architectural-feature identification.
